title: Exact degree-zero normalization of the root comparison
statement: Let T be a scheme, phi:A→B a homomorphism of commutative coefficient rings in the module universe, and N,M natural numbers annihilating A,B respectively. Let e be a CoefficientLineComparison phi N M hA hB T as in def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows. Then e.derivedIso.hom is the exact degree-zero adjunction insertion, in the sense of def-sp-exact-degree-zero-adjoint-interface, of the ordinary scalar adjunct of e.sheafIso.hom. The adjunctions and exact-single comparison are the published canonical ones. This is an equality of the specified maps, not the existence of a new comparison.

source.place: Part (3), orientation: rank-one sheaves and scalar-extension normalization; the exact single-object adjunct of the root-line comparison.

proof.text: Apply the proved scalar single-map adjoint-insertion formula to e.sheafIso.hom and compose the result with e.derived_normalization. This proves the claimed normalization without a representative choice or an additional hypothesis.

theorem CoefficientLineComparison.derived_eq_scalarInsertion
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {phi : A →+* B} {N M : ℕ} {hA : (N : A) = 0} {hB : (M : B) = 0}
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (e : CoefficientLineComparison phi N M hA hB T) :
    e.derivedIso.hom = SheafExactDegreeZero.scalarAdjointInsertion T.smallEtaleTopology phi
      ((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction phi T).homEquiv _ _ e.sheafIso.hom)
